description: A painted interior of a crowded log room with rough wooden walls and a ceiling of beams. Around forty people sit or stand in dark 19th-century dress, including women in bonnets and caps, children, and older men. A young man in a dark suit and cravat stands at right by a window, one hand raised and holding a book, while a seated clerk at a small wooden table writes on paper. The mood is warm and dim with window light on the right. No visible text, frame or border.
